description: Base Renovate configuration for Arillso repositories

packageRules.description: Pre-1.0 packages: SemVer does not guarantee backward compatibility; treat any non-patch bump as potentially breaking and require manual review.

Release binaries installed via helper actions (e.g. jaxxstorm/action-install-gh-release, aquasecurity/setup-trivy) are pinned by release tag, not by digest. Forcing pinDigests here makes Renovate fail with 'update failure' (Digest is not updated), so disable it for these uses-with inputs.

Docker images referenced as a bare version string (no @sha256 slot), e.g. kubesec/kubesec via an env var, cannot carry a digest. Forcing pinDigests makes Renovate fail with 'update failure' (Digest is not updated), so disable it for these.

arillso/.github - date tags, no digest pinning, weekly rollout. merge.yml cuts a YYYY-MM-DD tag on every push to main, so a daily schedule opens one PR per workflow change in every consumer repo (16 tags in the 30 days to 2026-09-12). Batching the rollout to Monday keeps the rolling-release model while cutting consumer PR churn to roughly 4 per month. `groupSlug` is what carries the schedule, not `groupName`: Renovate derives the branch from `slugify(groupSlug ?? groupName)` and evaluates `schedule` per branch, and packageRules merge last-wins per key - so the `groupSlug: all-non-major` from the non-major rule above survives a bare `groupName` override here (a tag bump like 2026-09-05 -> 2026-09-06 is a minor under this rule's own regex versioning, so that rule does match). Without an explicit groupSlug the bump lands on `renovate/all-non-major` and this window either does nothing or defers every other non-major update with it. `minimumReleaseAge` is deliberately waived: the Monday window is itself the soak, and a 1-day gate would push any tag cut over the weekend past the window and on to the next Monday, an 8-day lag. An urgent workflow fix is still reachable on demand via the Dependency Dashboard checkbox.

customManagers.description: Update versions in comments (renovate: datasource=... depName=...). An optional @sha256:... suffix is captured separately as currentDigest, so digest-pinned image references (e.g. image: repo:tag@sha256:...) update the digest instead of mangling the whole string into currentValue.
